title: Caroline Dell's notes from the Masters of Scale stage — 'An organization that can't be trusted can't endure'
summary: Dell is CEO and co-founder of Goodword, a partner of the Masters of Scale Summit. Her notes from the two days on LinkedIn observed that every main-stage session was about AI and every note she took was about people, and set Eric's session beside Sarah Friar, Reid Hoffman and Adam Grant on trust.
blockquote: Eric Ries: An organization that can’t be trusted can’t endure. Trustworthiness is an asset, and it powers everything else.
